title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Fee Charged Again: Charge for a Filing State Outside the Backing Term's State
content:
A re-charge out-of-state charge is added to a fee charged again under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), which is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It follows whether the filing state differs from the backing term's own state, and whether the two lie in the same state group.

- **Backing term's own state.** The garaging state of an Owner Auto Policy term, or the resident state of a Named Non-Owner Policy term.
- **State groups.** Florida and Virginia; Texas and Georgia; Arizona and Ohio.

| Filing state | Charge |
|---|---|
| in a different state group from the backing term's own state | 8.00 |
| a different state in the same state group | 4.00 |
| the backing term's own state | none |

**Hypothetical pairs (backing term's own state, then filing state)**

| Pair | Charge |
|---|---|
| Ohio, Texas | 8.00 |
| Texas, Georgia | 4.00 |
| Florida, Florida | none |
